entities.summary: Aaron Aaronsohn was a Romanian-born Jewish agronomist, botanist, and political activist, who lived most of his life in Zikhron Ya'akov. Aaronsohn was the discoverer of emmer, believed to be "the mother of wheat." He founded and was head of the NILI espionage network.
